sermon.title: Should I Be Baptized in The Holy Spirit? 02/10/2019
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer answers those who say the baptism of the Holy Ghost is not for today. The Spirit is poured out on all flesh, and the real proof of being filled is power to witness and serve God no matter what happens, whether or not one speaks in tongues.

chunks.section_question: Is the baptism of the Holy Ghost for today?
chunks.short_answer: Yes. The Bible says repent and be baptized and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Ghost, poured out on all flesh, not some flesh at a certain time.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Then Peter said to them, “Repent, and let every one of you be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ for the remission of sins; and you shall receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
“And it shall come to pass afterward That I will pour out My Spirit on all flesh; Your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, Your old men shall dream dreams, Your young men shall see visions.
Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high.”
But you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you; and you shall be witnesses to Me in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.”

chunks.section_question: What is the proof of being filled?
chunks.short_answer: The power to be a witness for Jesus, live for Him and be a light; you may speak in tongues or prophesy, but the real power is what Job had: to serve God no matter what happens.

faqs.question: Who should be filled with the Holy Spirit?
What did Jesus mean by “tarry in Jerusalem”?
faqs.answer: He was talking about the baptism of the Holy Ghost.

scriptures.text_nkjv: Behold, I send the Promise of My Father upon you; but tarry in the city of Jerusalem until you are endued with power from on high.”
But you shall receive power when the Holy Spirit has come upon you; and you shall be witnesses to Me in Jerusalem, and in all Judea and Samaria, and to the end of the earth.”

faqs.question: Does everyone filled speak in tongues?
faqs.answer: He says all flesh can have the power; it doesn’t mean all who have the Holy Ghost speak in tongues or prophesy.

faqs.question: Who leads us into all truth?
faqs.answer: The Holy Ghost, the Comforter; if we deny Him, how will we get all truth?

scriptures.text_nkjv: However, when He, the Spirit of truth, has come, He will guide you into all truth; for He will not speak on His own authority, but whatever He hears He will speak; and He will tell you things to come.

faqs.question: Can you be filled with the Holy Ghost?
Will people get healed?
faqs.answer: You may every once in a while pray for somebody and they get healed.

faqs.question: What if the crowd goes elsewhere?
faqs.answer: No matter where the crowd goes, I’m sticking with Jesus.
